To make Lisa's Special Medicine, I'll need 40 Orange Potions, 20 Blue Potions, 1 Antidote, and... 10 Star Pixie's Starpieces. Be careful fighting the Star Pixies!

QuestInfo.2: Lisa's Special Medicine is finally made! The sweet scent of it just makes it look that much more appealing to me, and I'm sure it will for Moppie.

0.0: All the cuts and wounds that have been caused by the monsters near Orbis can only be cured through my special medicine. It's something I can make with my eyes closed. What do you think? Do you want to make one?

yes.0: I'll need #b40 Orange Potions, 20 Blue Potions, 1 Antidote#k.
yes.1: You better be strong-willed if you intend on collecting those ingredients, because if not, you may put yourself in really serious, grave danger. Can you still do it?

no.0: Are you scared by the fact that your life may be in danger?

1.0: Really? You gathered up all the ingredients needed for the medicine? Alright, let's get this started! Oh, before we start, can I check and see if you have brought all the right ingredients for the medicine?
1.1: ...mix the potions well, and the mixing ratio is so important here... okay, now I need to boil it up, and ...throw in the Antidote... ooh, now we're getting there ...that's one indescribable color we're seeing... we're almost there ...
1.2: Lastly, add Star Pixie's Starpieces, and...

yes.0: A loud thud occurred, followed by a scintillating scent of sweetness covering the area.

item.0: Wait, why is this not responding? I don't think you brought all the ingredients needed for this.
